note: Written from the event history by Claude Sonnet 5.5. Camera is a function of (shot, local time, man pose from the track).

shots.name: ESTABLISH
shots.why: Whole room, closed. Wide orbit from the unseen corner.

shots.name: TRACK
shots.why: Follow shot from behind his right shoulder.

shots.name: FEET
shots.why: Low angle on the footsteps: every contact is an event.

shots.name: POV
shots.why: His view: head height, walk bob from the real gait phase.

shots.name: DOOR
shots.why: Lane shot toward the middle door, slow push.

shots.name: WINDOW
shots.why: If the door is open: from inside the made room, back at the doorway. Else: the window wall.

shots.name: TOP
shots.why: Top-down: the whole path is a line on the floor.
